res.postingTitle: ML Engineer - Automated Evaluation and Stress Testing
res.jobSummary:
The Product Evaluation team keeps the quality of AI-powered features high across a suite of everyday apps. The team is the main evaluation function: it produces the quality signals that guide model decisions and product launches.
This role builds and scales automated evaluation systems and designs stress-testing methods for several AI features. As features move from single answers to multi-turn, agent-style experiences, evaluation has to cover whole conversations, not single outputs.
res.description: Day to day, you will design, build and maintain automated evaluation systems that score AI feature quality at scale, including multi-turn conversation evaluation and end-to-end agent workflow tests. You will partner with engineers and designers to turn findings into fixes.
res.responsibilities:
Define and own the automated evaluation approach for AI features, turning qualitative ideas of quality into measurable, repeatable checks
Build stress tests that probe failure modes across single-turn and multi-turn experiences
Report evaluation results to product and model teams and help set launch bars
Improve the evaluation infrastructure so new features can be covered quickly
